description: Set the colour theme of a dashboard: page and surface backgrounds, text colours, brand colours and the chart series palette. All colours are hex values. Pass every field, since the theme is stored as one object.

chartSeriesColors.description: Explicit chart series palette. Leave empty to derive one from the brand colours.

primaryBrandColor.description: Main accent, used as the first chart series colour.

secondaryBrandColor.description: Secondary accent, used for the second chart series.

name: set_dashboard_theme
title: Set dashboard colours
